instruction: Apply the desktop image as the background to the first slide in LibreOffice Impress.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: This variation asks the user to add a background image to the first slide of the PowerPoint presentation. The evaluator checks if slide 0 has a background image by using the custom getter get_bg_image_in_slide__0a4467dd72d00d84bc5d80c765c4ad6f which extracts background image information from the PowerPoint XML structure. The metric check_bg_image_exists__0a4467dd72d00d84bc5d80c765c4ad6f verifies that a background image exists (result is not None). Verification: The original presentation does not have a background image on slide 0, so the task requires the user to add one.

Postconfig adequately saves file before verification to ensure changes are persisted
Complete coverage: instruction asks to set background image, evaluator verifies background image exists on first slide
